subject: Re: Follow-up: billing & invoice requirements for Stellara Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hernandez <tom.hernandez@stellarahealth.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@stellarahealth.com>, Linda Zhao <linda.zhao@stellarahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: billing & invoice requirements for Stellara Health

Hi Tom / Samantha / Linda,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the thoughtful conversation on expected usage patterns and procurement timelines. Per our call, I wanted to summarize the billing and procurement items we discussed and confirm next steps so your finance team has everything they need to get an order started.

Summary of ask / items we can provide:
- Invoice & supplier details: legal company name, remit-to address, Redwood Inference EIN/TIN, and example invoice format (we can attach a sample).
- Payment method: you mentioned preference for PO + wire or corporate card as fallback. Please confirm whether Stellara will require a PO for the initial subscription.
- Net terms: typical requests are Net 30 or Net 45. We can accommodate Net 30 pending credit approval — let us know if you need Net 45 or custom terms.
- Tax / VAT: confirm tax treatment and whether you require a W-9 or equivalent tax form (we can attach our W-9).
- Marketplace: you asked about AWS Marketplace billing instead of direct invoice — we support marketplace procurement. If you prefer that route we can connect you with our marketplace team and surface a marketplace quote.

Requested info from your side:
1) Billing contact and billing address (legal entity for invoicing)
2) Confirm PO required? If yes, approximate PO creation date and routing (Sourcing -> Legal -> Finance).
3) If you need any additional fields on the invoice (cost center, department code, purchase order number placement).

Attachments: I will attach our W-9 and a sample invoice layout. If you prefer a different invoice format, tell me the required fields and we will provide a tailored version.

Next steps: If you can reply with the billing contact and PO cadence, I’ll get our finance ops to prepare the formal quote and sample invoice for your procurement team. Happy to hop on a 15-min call with your finance/ops folks if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132
[Attachment: Redwood_W9.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: invoice_example-20260512.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Tom Hernandez <tom.hernandez@stellarahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Linda Zhao <linda.zhao@stellarahealth.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@stellarahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: billing & invoice requirements for Stellara Health

Marissa — thanks for the summary. Quick answers from procurement/finance:

1) Billing contact & address
- Finance contact: Linda Zhao (cc’d) — linda.zhao@stellarahealth.com
- Remit to / billing entity: Stellara Health, Inc.
- Billing address: 2100 Harbor Blvd, Suite 400, San Diego, CA 92101

2) PO requirement
- We do require a PO for any multi-month subscription or contract > $25k. For this initial pilot (~$12k expected) we can accept a corporate card but procurement prefers PO if the pilot extends beyond 3 months.

3) Net terms
- Standard is Net 30 for suppliers. For new vendors we typically do Net 30 after contract signature and vendor onboarding.

4) Invoice fields / tax
- On the invoice we need: PO number (when issued), our internal cost center (we’ll provide when PO is issued), vendor name, vendor tax ID / EIN, and a line-item breakdown with quantity, unit price, and period.
- For US vendors we require a W-9 on file (please attach). For vendors outside the US we require equivalent tax docs.

5) Marketplace
- AWS Marketplace is a possibility but prefer direct invoice for now — marketplace adds additional procurement steps on our side. We may revisit for long-term procurement.

Estimated timeline: procurement should be able to issue a PO if we decide to expand beyond the pilot — likely 2–3 weeks after internal approval (legal + sourcing). For the pilot, we’ll start with card payment and then switch to PO if we expand.

I’ve cc’d Linda for any follow-up on the invoice layout or specific remittance info.

Thanks,
Tom
Head of IT Procurement | Stellara Health
tom.hernandez@stellarahealth.com | (858) 555-1080

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:03:00 -07:00

Thanks Tom — that’s perfect and very helpful. Quick confirmations from our side:

- W-9 attached (Redwood_W9.pdf).
- We’ll generate an invoice template that includes: vendor name, Redwood EIN, line-item breakdown, period, and a PO field. I’m attaching an example invoice for your review (invoice_example-20260512.pdf).
- Net 30 is fine — we will mark the quote with Net 30 and note PO number placement.
- Marketplace: we’ll leave the marketplace option on the table but will proceed with direct invoice flow per your guidance.

Next steps on our side:
1) I’ll get finance ops to create a formal quote and sample invoice with the fields you requested and share it by EOD Wednesday.
2) If you want a short call with our finance ops to validate invoice formatting, I can set up a 15-min sync with Neha (cc’d) — she handles vendor onboarding and invoicing.

Can you confirm whether the pilot will be paid by corporate card now, or if you’d like Redwood to invoice and we bill to a PO once issued? If card, we can send a secure payment link once the quote is accepted.

Thanks again — looping Neha for onboarding + invoice prep.

Best,
Marissa

Aditya / Neha — forwarding Tom’s procurement reply. Key takeaways for deal desk / billing ops:
- Pilot likely paid by corporate card (~$12k) — potential switch to PO if pilot expands beyond 3 months.
- They require W-9 (attached) and Net 30 standard terms.
- Invoice needs PO field + cost center later.

Neha: can you please prepare the sample invoice and quote per their requested fields and add Net 30 on the quote? Also please confirm if we need vendor onboarding (W-9 receipt is fine) and whether we can provide a secure payment link for card payments for this pilot.

Aditya: FYI on timing — procurement timeline looks 2–3 weeks to issue PO if they expand. Recommend we offer 30 days of pilot credits to reduce friction; can we include that in the quote?

Thanks — I’ll hold off on sending the formal quote until Neha confirms the invoice sample and credit terms.

Marissa

thread_summary: Post-demo billing qualification with Stellara Health: customer prefers direct invoice for now, pilot paid by corporate card (~$12k) with possible PO if expanded; they require W-9, Net 30, PO field and cost-center on invoice. Redwood to provide sample invoice and quote; finance ops to confirm onboarding and payment link.
